Introduced hybrid name-priority scoring on top of semantic search so name-field matches always score above description-level hits across exhibitor entities.

Autocomplete endpoint removes substring noise, a blocker from the IMEX search pilot.
Routed partial-name typeahead through a dedicated fast autocomplete endpoint so over-lenient substring matching no longer floods AI search with noise.
Hive Requirement - search-noise blocker identified in the IMEX Qdrant pilot.
Added a separate prefix-indexed /autocomplete endpoint (~50ms) that keeps noisy substring behaviour out of full search and surfaces clean name suggestions.
Spaces and special characters breaking name matches
Handles spacing and special characters in names, a confirmed IMEX pilot blocker.
Made AI search resilient to spacing and special-character differences so a query like 'Visit Scotland' still finds 'VisitScotland'.
Hive Requirement - confirmed name-matching blocker for the IMEX pilot.
Tokeniser handling was fixed so spaced and unspaced/concatenated brand-name variants resolve to the correct exhibitor in top results.
No alias or multi-lingual variant handling
Multilingual name variant matching, a gap raised in the IMEX pilot.
Added cultural-name and diacritic tolerance to AI search so endonym/exonym variants (e.g. 'Italia' for 'Italy') return the right exhibitors.
Hive Requirement - multilingual matching gap raised in the IMEX pilot.
Combined semantic similarity with ascii_folding character normalisation so common language variants and diacritic differences surface relevant results instead of zero results.
Coordinator/partner ranking order in search, an IMEX pilot requirement.
Encoded the coordinator/partner hierarchy into AI search so exhibitor results follow a consistent parent/child ranking order.
Hive Requirement - hierarchy ranking requirement from the IMEX pilot.
Extracted the parent/child relationship from PostgreSQL into the Qdrant payload during ingestion, enabling coordinator-exact, partner-exact, coordinator-fuzzy, partner-fuzzy ordering.

Extended AI search coverage by indexing People, Sessions, Products and News so name matches across all entity types rank correctly.
Hive Requirement - entity-coverage gap identified in the IMEX pilot.
Indexed the People, News, Product and Session entities in Qdrant so exact name matches surface and rank above weaker description-level matches, consistent with other entity types.

Added fallback handling so a no-results query surfaces a no-results message with 'Did you mean...?' suggestions and category prompts rather than an empty page.
